sources.title: GitHub - Clearbox-AI/nerpii: A Python library to perform NER on ...
sources.snippet: Nerpii is a Python library developed to perform Named Entity Recognition (NER) on structured datasets and synthesize Personal Identifiable Information (PII). NER is performed with Presidio and with a NLP model available on HuggingFace, while the PII generation is based on Faker.
